releaseNotes: Platform release: the board-ready presentation boundary lands (platform/server/domain/presentation.mjs). Every engine- or system-authored text a founder sees now passes through a shared capability that presents it the way a chief of staff would present to the board — a curated board-language table for the full launch catalog, restated approval asks, a conservative jargon scrub for unknown steps, and an optional schema-validated AI polish hook (FORMATION_AI_PRESENTER_ENDPOINT) with deterministic fallback. The engine's own wording is preserved in each record's source and surfaces through an expandable Technical detail disclosure; founder-authored words are never rewritten. Open approval mirrors re-present themselves on sync as the table improves. The engine's state, reducer, and catalog are untouched; this manifest advances only to keep root package parity.

Surfaces wired through the boundary in the same release: approval mirrors (titles become 'Your go-ahead: …' with the restated ask as the decision statement, and open mirrors re-present themselves on sync as the board-language table improves), founder run-view steps (board title, what-it-gives-the-company summary, technical name alongside), execution projections and activity entries, imported deliverable drafts, result claims, and blocker tasks. The client gains a quiet TechnicalDisclosure primitive used on decision rows and the Launch page's engine section; platform/AGENTS.md records the rule so future surfaces route through the boundary. Domain coverage: 5 new tests including mirror re-presentation, 56 passing.
